subject: Is there a simple way to, upon a button click or some code in server.R, reset the inputs to default?

messages.author: 2ed19a7addb843f5
messages.subject: Is there a simple way to, upon a button click or some code in server.R, reset the inputs to default?
parts: I could probably to do this using renderUI in some way.But I'm thinking there might be a simpler way.... I essentially want the app to be reset to its original state.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Is there a simple way to, upon a button click or some code in server.R, reset the inputs to default?
parts:
With the latest version of Shiny on GitHub, this is doable but you need to manually reset the inputs from your code.

observe({
  if (input$actionButton == 0)
    return()

  isolate({
    # Reset each input using the appropriate update* function
    updateSelectInput(...)
    updateNumericInput(...)
  })
})

I could probably to do this using renderUI in some way.But I'm thinking there might be a simpler way.... I essentially want the app to be reset to its original state.
